question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 80 to
guide_solution: Summary The Olympic Games were named after the town of Olympic in Greece. The Olympic Games went on until 394. A.D. when the Roman Emperor stopped the games. After a period of 1500 years, the Olympic Games were reintroduced with the initiatives taken by a Frenchman named Baron Pierre de Coubertin. But the event was not limited to the Greeks only; it involved all the nations of the world. Modern Olympic has been linked up with the 185 increased almost at the same rate in next three years. In 2007, 2008 and 2009 the people for per square kilometer were 1,044.78, 1066.30 and 1083.70 respectively. It slowed down in 2010. In that year 1084.17 people lived in per square kilometers. The rate increased in 2011 and 2012. In 2012 the density of population reached the highest position. The graph illustrates the date vividly.
